confirmed: Configuration key is only the upstream cookie index; explicit SessionNId is authoritative.
A key collision cannot bypass a rotated SessionNId.
The source-session lookup contains all activity and identity predicates, so an unrelated duplicate SessionNId cannot hide a later valid record.
Tests use direct mapper checks without middleware revocation side effects.

Tests cover valid key/value divergence, rotation, missing field, inactive/deleted/disabled records, source/tenant/subject/security-version mismatch, and unrelated duplicate records before a valid record.
